meta.title: Course Registration | House of Mambo Bergen
meta.description: Register your interest for Salsa On2 and mambo courses with House of Mambo in Bergen.

registration.title: Course registration
registration.intro: Choose the course that fits your level and tell us a little about your dance experience. We will contact you about availability and the next steps.
notes: The full-time student price is NOK 690.
Partnerwork courses may use waiting lists to balance leaders and followers.
Your place is confirmed after you receive a reply from House of Mambo.
registration.helpText: Select the course that seems closest to your level and use the message field to tell us what you have danced before. We can help place you correctly.

placeholders.message: Questions, partner information, accessibility needs, or anything else you would like to share.

meta.title: Privacy Information | House of Mambo Bergen
meta.description: How House of Mambo Bergen handles course registration information.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.text: When you register your interest, we collect the contact, course, dance-experience, dance-role, and optional message information you provide.

sections.title: How it is used
sections.text: We use this information only to answer your enquiry, help select the appropriate course, manage course availability, and contact you about your registration.

sections.title: Storage and deletion
sections.text: Registration information will be stored in the connected Google service once the form connection is activated. Contact House of Mambo if you want to access, correct, or delete information you submitted.

sections.title: Before the form launches
sections.text: The registration form is currently in preview mode and does not send or store information. This page should be updated with a contact email and final retention period before public submissions are enabled.
